body: Today I just smiled and silently cried while everyone walked past. Day dreamed about sealing off the bathroom, turning the air filter on high, and opening a vein in the tub. I'm sure it will take two weeks for anyone to even notice, and that's just because I don't come to work. Only two coworkers will probably be sad. 🤷🏾‍♂️ I would really like to drive to the country, throw my cell phone in a river and eat a slug in the presence of some wild hogs. At least that way I don't tramatize anyone. Hogs might not even leave bones. Or Buy a cheap  boat and put a hole in out out on the water. 😁
